subject: storytime
title: Make Way for Ducklings words
about: Mr. and Mrs. Mallard search for a safe home to raise their family, and once the ducklings hatch, Mrs. Mallard leads them through busy city streets with help from a kind policeman. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, counting the ducklings on every page.

book.author: Robert McCloskey
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A duck family waddles across a busy city to reach its new home in the park.

cards.note: capital M, it is their name; ll is one l; two parts: Mal-lard; the ar says er here: Mal-erd
ck is one sound; ng is one part; two parts: duck-lings
all regular; s-t at the end
gg is two letters, one sound; the s says z
tch is one sound, like ch
all regular; n-d at the end
the i says its name and the s is quiet: eye-land
two parts: riv-er; er says er
ea says long e; two parts: pea-nuts
two parts: po-lice; the o says uh, the i says ee, the c says s and the e is quiet: puh-lees
a says aw after w; er says er: waw-ter
qu says kw; ck is one sound
magic e makes i say its name
b-r blend; dge says j, like in edge
s-w blend; a says o after w: swon
ar says ar; two parts: gar-den
